003import java.util.HashMap;
004import java.util.Map;
005
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;

020
021public class CoreRuleTokenReplacementGeneratorImpl implements RuleTokenReplacementGeneratorPlugin {
022
023        public Map<String, String> getTokenReplacements(String ruleId, Object entity, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
024                
025                SectorEntityToken target = null;
026                PersonAPI person = null;
027                MarketAPI market = null;
028                FactionAPI faction = null;
029                FactionAPI personFaction = null;
030                if (entity instanceof SectorEntityToken) {
031                        target = (SectorEntityToken) entity;
032                        market = target.getMarket();
033                        faction = target.getFaction();
034                }
035                
036                if (entity instanceof CampaignFleetAPI && market == null) {
037                        market = Misc.getSourceMarket((CampaignFleetAPI) entity);
038                }
039                
040                if (entity instanceof SectorEntityToken) {
041                        person = ((SectorEntityToken) entity).getActivePerson();
042                }
043                
044                if (person == null) {
045                        if (entity instanceof CampaignFleetAPI) {
046                                person = ((CampaignFleetAPI) entity).getCommander();
047                        } else if (entity instanceof PersonAPI ){
048                                person = (PersonAPI) entity; // can't actually happen as entity is always a SectorEntityToken
049                        }
050                }
051                
052                if (person != null) {
053                        personFaction = person.getFaction();
054                }
055                
056                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
057                
058                Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<String, String>();
059
060                map.put("$Playername", Global.getSector().getCharacterData().getName());
061                map.put("$playername", Global.getSector().getCharacterData().getName());
062                map.put("$playerName", Global.getSector().getCharacterData().getName());
063                map.put("$PlayerName", Global.getSector().getCharacterData().getName());
064                
065                map.put("$playerFirstName", Global.getSector().getCharacterData().getPerson().getName().getFirst());
066                map.put("$playerFirstname", Global.getSector().getCharacterData().getPerson().getName().getFirst());
067                map.put("$PlayerFirstName", Global.getSector().getCharacterData().getPerson().getName().getFirst());
068                String last = Global.getSector().getCharacterData().getPerson().getName().getLast();
069                if (last == null || last.isBlank()) {
070                        last = Global.getSector().getCharacterData().getPerson().getName().getFirst();
071                }
072                map.put("$playerLastName", last);
073                map.put("$playerLastname", last);
074                map.put("$PlayerLastName", last);
075                
076                PersonAPI playerPerson = Global.getSector().getPlayerPerson();
077                String honorific = Global.getSector().getCharacterData().getHonorific();
078                if (playerPerson != null) {
079                        if (playerPerson.isMale()) {
080                                map.put("$playerSirOrMadam", "sir");
081                                map.put("$PlayerSirOrMadam", "Sir");
082                                
083                                map.put("$playerBrotherOrSister", "brother");
084                                map.put("$PlayerBrotherOrSister", "Brother");
085                                
086                                map.put("$playerHisOrHer", "his");
087                                map.put("$PlayerHisOrHer", "His");
088                                map.put("$playerHimOrHer", "him");
089                                map.put("$PlayerHimOrHer", "Him");
090                                map.put("$playerHeOrShe", "he");
091                                map.put("$PlayerHeOrShe", "He");
092                        } else {
093                                map.put("$playerSirOrMadam", "ma'am");
094                                map.put("$PlayerSirOrMadam", "Ma'am");
095                                
096                                map.put("$playerBrotherOrSister", "sister");
097                                map.put("$PlayerBrotherOrSister", "Sister");
098                                
099                                map.put("$playerHisOrHer", "her");
100                                map.put("$PlayerHisOrHer", "Her");
101                                map.put("$playerHimOrHer", "her");
102                                map.put("$PlayerHimOrHer", "Her");
103                                map.put("$playerHeOrShe", "she");
104                                map.put("$PlayerHeOrShe", "She");
105                        }
106                        
107                        if (honorific != null && !honorific.isEmpty()) {
108                                map.put("$playerSirOrMadam", Misc.lcFirst(honorific));
109                                map.put("$PlayerSirOrMadam", honorific);
110                                
111                                if (!Misc.SIR.toLowerCase().equals(honorific.toLowerCase()) && 
112                                        !Misc.MAAM.toLowerCase().equals(honorific.toLowerCase())) {
113                                        map.put("$playerBrotherOrSister", "walker");
114                                        map.put("$PlayerBrotherOrSister", "Walker");
115                                }
116                        }
117                }
118                
119                if (market != null) {
120                        //map.put("$market", market.getName());
121                        map.put("$marketName", market.getName());
122                        map.put("$MarketName", market.getName());
123                        
124                        if (target.getLocation() instanceof StarSystemAPI) {
125                                map.put("$marketSystem", ((StarSystemAPI)target.getLocation()).getBaseName() + " star system");
126                        } else {
127                                map.put("$marketSystem", "hyperspace");
128                        }
129                        
130                        MemoryAPI mem = market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
131                        if (mem.contains(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PLAYER_HOSTILE_ACTIVITY_NEAR_MARKET)) {
132                                float expire = mem.getExpire(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PLAYER_HOSTILE_ACTIVITY_NEAR_MARKET);
133                                String days = Misc.getAtLeastStringForDays((int) expire);
134                                map.put("$playerHostileTimeoutStr", days.toLowerCase());
135                                mem.set("$playerHostileTimeoutStr", days.toLowerCase(), 0);
136                        }
137                }
138                
139                if (target != null) {
140                        map.put("$entityName", target.getName());
141                        map.put("$fleetName", target.getName().toLowerCase());
142                        map.put("$relayName", target.getName());
143                        
144                        
145                        if (target.getCustomEntityType() != null) {
146                                if (target.getCustomEntitySpec() != null) {
147                                        CustomEntitySpecAPI spec = target.getCustomEntitySpec();
148                                        map.put("$nameInText", spec.getNameInText());
149                                        map.put("$shortName", spec.getShortName());
150                                        map.put("$isOrAre", spec.getIsOrAre());
151                                        map.put("$aOrAn", spec.getAOrAn());
152                                }
153                        }
154                        
155//                      map.put("$factionEntityPrefix", target.getFaction().getEntityNamePrefix());
156//                      map.put("$FactionEntityPrefix", Misc.ucFirst(target.getFaction().getEntityNamePrefix()));
157                        if (target.getFaction() != null) {
158                                String factionName = target.getFaction().getEntityNamePrefix();
159                                if (factionName == null || factionName.isEmpty()) {
160                                        factionName = target.getFaction().getDisplayName();
161                                }
162
163                                map.put("$factionAOrAn", target.getFaction().getPersonNamePrefixAOrAn());
164                                
165                                map.put("$factionIsOrAre", target.getFaction().getDisplayNameIsOrAre());
166                                
167                                map.put("$faction", factionName);
168                                map.put("$ownerFaction", factionName);
169                                map.put("$marketFaction", factionName);
170                                map.put("$Faction", Misc.ucFirst(factionName));
171                                map.put("$OwnerFaction", Misc.ucFirst(factionName));
172                                map.put("$MarketFaction", Misc.ucFirst(factionName));
173                                map.put("$theFaction", target.getFaction().getDisplayNameWithArticle());
174                                map.put("$theOwnerFaction", target.getFaction().getDisplayNameWithArticle());
175                                map.put("$theMarketFaction", target.getFaction().getDisplayNameWithArticle());
176                                map.put("$TheFaction", Misc.ucFirst(target.getFaction().getDisplayNameWithArticle()));
177                                map.put("$TheOwnerFaction", Misc.ucFirst(target.getFaction().getDisplayNameWithArticle()));
178                                map.put("$TheMarketFaction", Misc.ucFirst(target.getFaction().getDisplayNameWithArticle()));
179                                
180                                map.put("$factionLong", target.getFaction().getDisplayNameLong());
181                                map.put("$FactionLong", Misc.ucFirst(target.getFaction().getDisplayNameLong()));
182                                map.put("$theFactionLong", target.getFaction().getDisplayNameLongWithArticle());
183                                map.put("$TheFactionLong", Misc.ucFirst(target.getFaction().getDisplayNameLongWithArticle()));
184                        }
185                }
186                
187                if (target != null) {
188                        map.put("$entityName", target.getName());
189                        map.put("$fleetName", target.getName().toLowerCase());
190                        map.put("$relayName", target.getName());
191                        
192//                      map.put("$factionEntityPrefix", target.getFaction().getEntityNamePrefix());
193//                      map.put("$FactionEntityPrefix", Misc.ucFirst(target.getFaction().getEntityNamePrefix()));
194                        if (target.getFaction() != null) {
195                                String factionName = target.getFaction().getEntityNamePrefix();
196                                if (factionName == null || factionName.isEmpty()) {
197                                        factionName = target.getFaction().getDisplayName();
198                                }
199
200                                map.put("$factionIsOrAre", target.getFaction().getDisplayNameIsOrAre());
201                                
202                                map.put("$faction", factionName);
203                                map.put("$ownerFaction", factionName);
204                                map.put("$marketFaction", factionName);
205                                map.put("$Faction", Misc.ucFirst(factionName));
206                                map.put("$OwnerFaction", Misc.ucFirst(factionName));
207                                map.put("$MarketFaction", Misc.ucFirst(factionName));
208                                map.put("$theFaction", target.getFaction().getDisplayNameWithArticle());
209                                map.put("$theOwnerFaction", target.getFaction().getDisplayNameWithArticle());
210                                map.put("$theMarketFaction", target.getFaction().getDisplayNameWithArticle());
211                                map.put("$TheFaction", Misc.ucFirst(target.getFaction().getDisplayNameWithArticle()));
212                                map.put("$TheOwnerFaction", Misc.ucFirst(target.getFaction().getDisplayNameWithArticle()));
213                                map.put("$TheMarketFaction", Misc.ucFirst(target.getFaction().getDisplayNameWithArticle()));
214                                
215                                map.put("$factionLong", target.getFaction().getDisplayNameLong());
216                                map.put("$FactionLong", Misc.ucFirst(target.getFaction().getDisplayNameLong()));
217                                map.put("$theFactionLong", target.getFaction().getDisplayNameLongWithArticle());
218                                map.put("$TheFactionLong", Misc.ucFirst(target.getFaction().getDisplayNameLongWithArticle()));
219                        }
220                }
221                
222                
223                String shipOrFleet = "fleet";
224                if (playerFleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy().size() == 1) {
225                        shipOrFleet = "ship";
226                        if (playerFleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy().get(0).isFighterWing()) {
227                                shipOrFleet = "fighter wing";
228                        }
229                }
230                map.put("$shipOrFleet", shipOrFleet);
231                map.put("$fleetOrShip", shipOrFleet);
232                map.put("$ShipOrFleet", Misc.ucFirst(shipOrFleet));
233                map.put("$FleetOrShip", Misc.ucFirst(shipOrFleet));
234                
235                if (target instanceof CampaignFleetAPI) {
236                        CampaignFleetAPI fleet = (CampaignFleetAPI) target;
237                        String otherShipOrFleet = "fleet";
238                        if (fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy().size() == 1) {
239                                shipOrFleet = "ship";
240                                if (fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy().get(0).isFighterWing()) {
241                                        shipOrFleet = "fighter wing";
242                                }
243                        }
244                        map.put("$otherShipOrFleet", otherShipOrFleet);
245                        
246                        map.put("$otherFleetName", fleet.getName().toLowerCase());
247                }
248                
249                if (person != null) {
250                        if (person.isMale()) {
251                                map.put("$hisOrHer", "his");
252                                map.put("$HisOrHer", "His");
253                                map.put("$himOrHer", "him");
254                                map.put("$HimOrHer", "Him");
255                                map.put("$heOrShe", "he");
256                                map.put("$HeOrShe", "He");
257                                map.put("$himOrHerself", "himself");
258                                map.put("$HimOrHerself", "Himself");
259                                map.put("$manOrWoman", "man");
260                                map.put("$ManOrWoman", "Man");
261                                map.put("$brotherOrSister", "brother");
262                                map.put("$BrotherOrSister", "Brother");
263                                map.put("$sirOrMadam", "sir");
264                                map.put("$SirOrMadam", "Sir");
265                        } else {
266                                map.put("$hisOrHer", "her");
267                                map.put("$HisOrHer", "Her");
268                                map.put("$himOrHer", "her");
269                                map.put("$HimOrHer", "Her");
270                                map.put("$heOrShe", "she");
271                                map.put("$HeOrShe", "She");
272                                map.put("$himOrHerself", "herself");
273                                map.put("$HimOrHerself", "Herself");
274                                map.put("$manOrWoman", "woman");
275                                map.put("$ManOrWoman", "Woman");
276                                map.put("$brotherOrSister", "sister");
277                                map.put("$BrotherOrSister", "Sister");
278                                map.put("$sirOrMadam", "ma'am");
279                                map.put("$SirOrMadam", "Ma'am");
280                        }
281                        
282                        if (person.getRank() != null) {
283                                map.put("$personRank", person.getRank().toLowerCase());
284                                map.put("$PersonRank", Misc.ucFirst(person.getRank()));
285                        }
286                        
287                        if (person.getPost() != null) {
288                                map.put("$personPost", person.getPost().toLowerCase());
289                                map.put("$PersonPost", Misc.ucFirst(person.getPost()));
290                        }
291                        
292                        map.put("$PersonName", person.getName().getFullName());
293                        map.put("$PersonFirstName", person.getName().getFirst());
294                        map.put("$PersonLastName", person.getName().getLast());
295                        map.put("$personName", person.getName().getFullName());
296                        map.put("$personFirstName", person.getName().getFirst());
297                        map.put("$personLastName", person.getName().getLast());
298                }
299                
300                
301                if (faction != null) {
302                        float rel = faction.getRelationship(Factions.PLAYER);
303                        RepLevel level = RepLevel.getLevelFor(rel);
304                        map.put("$relAdjective", level.getDisplayName().toLowerCase());
305                }
306                
307                if (personFaction != null) {
308                        String factionName = personFaction.getEntityNamePrefix();
309                        if (factionName == null || factionName.isEmpty()) {
310                                factionName = personFaction.getDisplayName();
311                        }
312
313                        map.put("$personFactionIsOrAre", personFaction.getDisplayNameIsOrAre());
314                        
315                        map.put("$personFaction", factionName);
316                        map.put("$PersonFaction", Misc.ucFirst(factionName));
317                        map.put("$thePersonFaction", personFaction.getDisplayNameWithArticle());
318                        map.put("$ThePersonFaction", Misc.ucFirst(personFaction.getDisplayNameWithArticle()));
319                        
320                        map.put("$personFactionLong", personFaction.getDisplayNameLong());
321                        map.put("$PersonFactionLong", Misc.ucFirst(personFaction.getDisplayNameLong()));
322                        map.put("$thePersonFactionLong", personFaction.getDisplayNameLongWithArticle());
323                        map.put("$ThePersonFactionLong", Misc.ucFirst(personFaction.getDisplayNameLongWithArticle()));
324                }
325                
326                return map;
327        }
328
329}
